items.text: Futhi ngema ngomnyaka wokuqala kaDariyu umMede ukuba ngimqinise, ngimqinise.

Manje ngizokutshela iqiniso. Bheka, kusayakuvela amakhosi amathathu ePheresiya; futhi owesine uyoceba kakhulu kunabo bonke, futhi ngamandla ayo ngengcebo yakhe uyovusa bonke bamelene nombuso waseGrisi.
Futhi kuyovela inkosi enamandla, eyobusa ngegunya elikhulu futhi yenze ngokwentando yayo.

Lapho isisukuma, umbuso wayo uyakwaphulwa, uhlukaniselwe emimoyeni yomine yezulu; futhi hhayi inzalo yakhe noma ngokombuso wakhe ayebusa phezu kwawo; ngoba umbuso wayo uzahlwithwa, labanye ngaphandle kwabo.
Inkosi yaseningizimu iyakuba namandla, nesinye sezikhulu zayo; uyakuba namandla phezu kwakhe, abuse; ukubusa kwakhe kuyoba ukubusa okukhulu.

Futhi ekupheleni kweminyaka bayobutha; ngoba indodakazi yenkosi yaseningizimu iyakuza enkosini yasenyakatho ukwenza isivumelwano; kepha akayikuwagcina amandla ompofu; futhi yena ngeke ame, noma ingalo yakhe, kodwa uyonikelwa, futhi labo abamlethayo nabamzalayo, futhi lowo owamqinisa ngalezi zikhathi.
Kodwa egatsheni lezimpande zawo kuyovela omunye ezweni lakubo, oyofika nebutho lempi, angene enqabeni yenkosi yaseNyakatho, abhekane nabo futhi anqobe.
Futhi bayoletha ekuthunjweni onkulunkulu babo, kanye nezikhulu zabo kanye nezitsha zabo eziyigugu zesiliva nezegolide, eGibhithe; futhi uzohlala isikhathi eside kunenkosi yasenyakatho.
Ngakho inkosi yaseningizimu iyakungena embusweni wayo, ibuyele ezweni layo.
Kodwa amadodana akhe ayovuswa futhi abuthele ndawonye isixuku samabutho amakhulu; omunye ngokuqinisekile uyofika futhi akhukhule akhukhule; khona-ke uyobuya futhi afike enqabeni yakhe ematasa.
Inkosi yaseningizimu iyakuzonda, iphume, ilwe nayo, inkosi yasenyakatho; futhi iyovusa isixuku esikhulu; kepha isixuku siyakunikelwa esandleni sakhe.
Futhi uma Esusa isixuku, inhliziyo yakhe iyophakama; uyakuwisa amashumi ezinkulungwane eziningi, kepha ngalokho akayikuziqinisa.
Ngokuba inkosi yaseNyakatho iyakubuya, ibuthe isixuku esikhulu kunesokuqala, futhi ngokuqinisekile iyofika ngemva kweminyaka ethile inempi enkulu nengcebo eningi.
Ngalezo zikhathi abaningi bayovukela inkosi yaseNingizimu; futhi abaphangi babantu bakho bayoziphakamisa ukuze baqinisekise umbono; kodwa bayakuwa.
Ngalokho inkosi yasenyakatho iyakufika, iphakamise intaba, ithathe imizi ebiyelweyo kakhulu;
Kodwa lowo oza ngokumelene naye uyokwenza njengentando yakhe, futhi akekho oyokuma phambi kwakhe; futhi uyokuma ezweni elikhazimulayo eliyoqedwa ngesandla sakhe.
Iyakubhekisa ubuso bayo ukungena ngamandla ombuso wayo wonke, nabaqotho kanye nayo; uyakwenza njalo: uyakumnika indodakazi yabesifazane, ayichithe; kodwa ngeke ame ngakuyo futhi angabi ngakuye.
Ngemva kwalokho uyophendulela ubuso bakhe eziqhingini futhi athathe eziningi; ngaphandle kwesihlamba sakhe uyakusiphendulela kuye.
Khona-ke uyophendulela ubuso bakhe enqabeni yezwe lakhe, kodwa uyokhubeka awe, angatholakali.
Epalini yakhe kuyakuvela ukwanda kwentela enkazimulweni yombuso; kodwa ngezinsuku ezimbalwa izabhujiswa, kungabi ngolaka kumbe ngempi.
Empahleni yakhe kuyakuvela umuntu odelelayo, abangayikumnika udumo lombuso; kodwa uyongena ngokuthula futhi azuze ubukhosi ngokuthopha.
Futhi ngezingalo zikazamcolo bayakukhungatheka, baphuke phambi kobuso bakhe; yebo, nombusi wesivumelwano.
Futhi ngemva kokwenza isivumelwano naye, uyosebenza ngobuqili, ngoba uyokhuphuka futhi abe namandla kanye nesizwe esincane.

Uyakungena ngokuthula ezindaweni ezivundile zesifunda; futhi kumelwe enze lokho okhokho bakhe noyise abangazange bakwenze; impango nempango nengcebo uyakukuhlakaza phakathi kwabo; yebo, futhi uyokhipha amacebo akhe ngokumelene nezinqaba, yebo, okwesikhashana.

Uyakuvusa amandla akhe nesibindi sakhe enkosini yaseningizimu ngempi enkulu; inkosi yaseningizimu iyakuvuswa ukulwa nempi enkulu kakhulu nenamandla; kodwa ngeke abe khona, ngoba bayobikezela amacebo ngokumelene naye.
Yebo, labo abadla isabelo sokudla kwakhe bayoyibhubhisa, futhi impi yayo iyokhukhulwa, futhi abaningi bayowa bebulewe.
Futhi izinhliziyo zalawa makhosi omabili ziyoba ukwenza okubi, futhi bayokhuluma amanga etafuleni elilodwa; kodwa ngeke kube nempumelelo, ngoba nokho ukuphela kuyoba ngesikhathi esimisiwe.
Iyakubuyela ezweni layo nengcebo enkulu; futhi inhliziyo yakhe iyomelana nesivumelwano esingcwele; futhi iyokwenza izenzo futhi ibuyele ezweni layo.
Ngesikhathi esimisiwe kumelwe abuyele emuva futhi eze eningizimu; kodwa kakuyikuba njengokuqala kumbe okokugcina.

Ngokuba imikhumbi yaseKitimi iyakufika kuye; ngakho-ke uyoba lusizi futhi abuye futhi athukuthelele isivumelwano esingcwele; kanjalo uzokwenza; uyobuya futhi abe nokuqonda nabashiya isivumelwano esingcwele.
Futhi izikhali ziyokuma eceleni kwakhe, futhi ziyongcolisa indlu engcwele yamandla, futhi zisuse umhlatshelo wezinsuku zonke, futhi ziyomisa isinengiso esenza incithakalo.
Futhi labo abenza okubi ngokumelene nesivumelwano, uyobabhubhisa ngokuthopha; kepha abantu abamaziyo uNkulunkulu wabo bayakuba namandla, benze izenzo.
Abahlakaniphileyo phakathi kwezizwe bayofundisa abaningi, kodwa bayokuwa izinsuku eziningi ngenkemba, nangelangabi, nangokuthunjwa nangokuphanga.
Futhi uma bewa, bayothathwa ngosizo oluncane, kodwa abaningi bayobalandela ngokuthopha.
Abanye kwabahlakaniphileyo bayakuwa ukubavivinya, abahlambulule, abenze mhlophe kuze kube yisikhathi sokuphela, ngokuba kusengokwesikhathi esimisiweyo.

Futhi inkosi kumelwe yenze ngokwentando yayo; iyoziphakamisa, izikhulise phezu kwabo bonke onkulunkulu, ikhulume izimangaliso ngoNkulunkulu wawonkulunkulu, ibe nempumelelo, kuze kuphele ulaka; ngoba okumisiweyo kuzokwenzeka.
Ayiyikunakekela uNkulunkulu wawoyise, inganaki isifiso sabesifazane nanoma yimuphi unkulunkulu; ngoba iyozikhulisa ngaphezu kwakho konke.
Kepha empahleni yayo iyodumisa uNkulunkulu Sebawoti, nonkulunkulu oyise ababengamazi, iyomdumisa ngegolide, nangesiliva, nangamatshe anqabileyo, nangezinto ezithandekayo.
Iyakwenza kanjalo ezinqabeni ngonkulunkulu wabezizwe, abayomazi, andise ngenkazimulo; futhi iyobenza babuse phezu kwabaningi futhi ihlukanise izwe libe yinzuzo.

“Ngesikhathi sokuphela inkosi yaseningizimu iyoyihlasela, inkosi yasenyakatho ihlangabezane nayo njengesivunguvungu, inezinqola, nabamahhashi, nangemikhumbi eminingi; futhi iyongena emazweni futhi ikhukhule idlule.
Futhi iyongena ezweni elikhazimulayo, futhi amazwe amaningi ayochithwa; kodwa bayophunyuka esandleni sakhe, u-Edomi noMowabi nezikhulu zabantwana bakwa-Amoni.
Futhi uyokwelulela isandla sakhe emazweni, futhi izwe laseGibhithe ngeke liphunyuke.
Kodwa iyoba namandla phezu kwengcebo yegolide nesiliva naphezu kwazo zonke izinto eziyigugu zaseGibhithe, futhi amaLibhiya namaKushe ayolandela ezinyathelweni zayo.
Kodwa izindaba ezivela empumalanga nasenyakatho ziyomethusa; ngakho-ke iyohamba ngokufutheka okukhulu ukuze ibhubhise abaningi futhi ishaye ngesiqalekiso.
Iyakutshala izindlwana zendlu yayo phakathi kolwandle entabeni engcwele yenkazimulo; nokho iyofika ekupheleni kwayo, futhi akekho oyoyisiza.
